text:
Sven: Hackathon running late  anyone up for late-night snacks after the demo? Thinking around Hackescher Markt, 10:30pm-ish.
Mira: I'm in. Need something open late  and preferably veggie-friendly.
Zoe: Mustafa's is iconic but the line can be wild. Still worth it for the kebab. :meat_on_bone:
Tom: If we want sit-down, The Bird (burgers) nearby is open late-ish and has veggie burger.
Aisha: There's a little Vietnamese place, Pho & Go, that's chill and late. Good for groups and has tofu options.
Ben: Bakery option: Zeit ffcr Brot does amazing cinnamon rolls but closes around 10 usually. Tight timing.
Lina: Quick vote: react :one: Mustafa's kebap  :two: The Bird burgers  :three: Pho & Go  :four: Walk to bakery (if we hustle)
Mira: :three:
Zoe: :one: (I will wait in line)
Tom: :two:
Aisha: :three: (pho + tea sounds perfect)
Sven: Looks like Pho & Go or Mustafa's. Lina can you check opening hours and whether Pho & Go can take ~8? We might have two extra people joining. Also we have one halal preference and one gluten-free.
Lina: Calling Pho & Go now...
Lina: Pho & Go can do 8-10 people at 10:30, walk-in preferred but they'll hold a corner table if we arrive by 10:20. They confirmed vegetarian broth and GF rice noodle option. Phone conf: PG-784.
Sven: Awesome. Can someone post meetup spot and coords? I'll put it on the calendar.
Zoe: I'll paste a quick pin:
```
Meet at Hackescher Markt main entrance (U-Bahn stairs) -> walk 3 min south to Pho & Go, Rosenthaler Str. 18. Meet 10:20pm.
```
Tom: Reimbursements? I can pick up and get receipts. Anyone needs Uber back?
Aisha: I can cover one round; please file for snack receipts under "team meals - hackathon".
Ben: I'll probably grab a taxi home after.
calendar-bot: Event added to #team-calendar  "Hackathon snacks: Pho & Go 10:30pm".
snack-bot: Reminder: Pho & Go noted veg broth + GF rice noodles. Bring cash just in case; some smaller places prefer card terminal only for >15 EUR.
Sven: Perfect. See you all 10:20pm at Hackescher Markt. Thanks y'all! :raised_hands:
